show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Leigh Drogen - Sink or Swim--How to Combine Quant and Traditional Asset Management Techniques - Invest Like the Best, EP.48]
summary: Because of the rise of quants, many are asking themselves how to survive and thrive in a changing industry. In short, how can traditional managers compete with quants? This second conversation with Leigh was set up to answer many of the questions posed in the first one.

thesis: The podcast argues that traditional asset managers must shift their mindset from a hierarchical, ego-driven structure to a hybrid model that combines quantitative techniques with traditional discretionary approaches. This transition requires portfolio managers to adopt a 'quarterback' or 'offensive coordinator' role where they delegate decision-making authority to researchers and data systems rather than controlling every aspect of the investment process.
